brief:
Israeli forces shot and critically wounded a Palestinian during a military operation in the Al-Am'ari refugee camp in Al-Bireh, in the central West Bank, on Tuesday evening, according to IMEMC News. The Palestinian Health Ministry confirmed the shooting following the incursion into the camp.

The circumstances surrounding the incident remained unclear. No additional details were immediately available regarding the identity of the wounded Palestinian or the specific events that preceded the shooting during the military operation.

title: Israeli forces critically wound Palestinian in Al-Am'ari camp raid
